recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-5466 unless a future build moves the Observation introduction text and reintroduces the typo.
issue_request: FHIR-5466 was Published with a Persuasive resolution for an OO January 2015 ballot technical correction asking that Observation section 4.20.1 change "the DiagnosticReport resource provide a clinical or workflow context" to "the DiagnosticReport resource provides a clinical or workflow context".
initial_application: No exact FHIR-5466-tagged source commit was found in the current local history. The relevant Observation introduction source later passed through typo-cleanup history, including bf5343ad3c, which corrected the same sentence from "providess" to "provides"; subsequent Observation introduction edits preserved the corrected verb.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and source/observation/observation-introduction.xml is the current build-scope narrative location for the related Observation page. The other Jira related artifact, DeviceObservationReport, is listed under [removed-resources] in source/fhir.ini, so no current DeviceObservationReport source edit is needed. Direct Jira-key community searches found no Zulip or Confluence discussion that changes the straightforward typo-correction conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative Observation introduction already says that the DiagnosticReport resource "provides a clinical or workflow context" and no stale current source occurrence of the requested wrong wording was found.
